connection.name: Illustrative City Centre connection
connection.basis: Author-selected waypoints through the broad Kipling, Sherway, Dundas, Cooksville and City Centre study areas. Inspired by historical TTC D3 discussion and the 24 September 2026 campaign announcement. Not traced as an approved route from either source.
connection.display: Purple dashed cartographic overlay, projected over the city for legibility. It is not physical rails, a road, a tunnel, or an elevated guideway. Display y values carry no engineering meaning.
